hotels.title: Singapore Robertson Quay Riverfront Escape with Club Lounge Access & Two-Hour Free-Flow Cocktails
hotels.description: All of the garden city's spoils are within reach at this riverfront five-star hotel in Robertson Quay, Singapore's bountiful heritage and arts district. Just a short ride on your hired bike from Orchard Road and Marina Bay Sands, and only minutes from the centre of blooming Singapore city, this ultra-modern hotel couldn't be better placed for exploration. With a wealth of exceptional facilities onsite, there are plenty of reasons to stay in too. Explore international gastronomy across five restaurants and bars, including the riverfront Italian ristorante, a Japanese fine dining spot, a New York-inspired steakhouse and a cocktail bar with tea-infused tipples. Enjoy Singapore's year-round sun with a dip in the pool, relieve stress in the fitness centre and journey further into the sprawling cityscape with recommendations from the concierge team. Discover lesser-known gems, botanical gardens, national galleries and parklands, all at your fingertips.
